page_topic_one_liner: Website indexing — check status, diagnose coverage issues, fix robots/noindex/canonical blockers in GSC
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional index coverage SEO education, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must show GSC-style index coverage status breakdown (indexed vs excluded vs error) — NOT an AI chat panel or generic database icon alone.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Index coverage status dashboard — stacked horizontal bar segments: green Indexed (largest), grey Excluded, red Error (smallest), with blurred reason-code rows beneath (Crawled not indexed, Blocked by robots.txt, Duplicate without canonical)
Secondary: site:yourdomain.com search operator bar with blurred indexed result count
Tertiary: URL Inspection magnifier icon on single page tile showing Valid / Indexed status badge
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is index coverage not GEO)
Generic database cylinder without coverage status breakdown
Real Google Search Console screenshot with branding
